title: This Side of Paradise
author: F. Scott Fitzgerald
summary: Amory Blaine, a charming, self-regarding young man, goes from prep school to Princeton and then into the Jazz Age. Along the way he drifts through romances, ambitions and losses.
readIf: you enjoy early Fitzgerald and sharp, stylised portraits of young people in the 1920s.
skipIf: you want a tightly plotted story or a character you easily root for.
